user.title: IO-Darts hub
user.description: Address of the IO-Darts-Agent hub, e.g. http://192.168.41.108:3000. Username and password only when web login is enabled on the hub. The hub module "homeassistant" must be installed and running.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to the hub again

error.invalid_url: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.
error.module_missing: The hub module "homeassistant" is not installed or not running.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.

trigger_intent.name: Trigger intent
trigger_intent.description: Emits homeassistant.trigger_<slot> on the hub; other modules (WLED, caller) react as configured in the hub.

data.name: Data
data.description: Optional text passed with the intent (max. 200 characters).

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one hub.

module_missing.title: IO-Darts hub module missing
module_missing.description: The hub module "homeassistant" is not installed or not running. Install or start it in the hub UI; match data and intents are unavailable until then.

no_hub.message: No IO-Darts hub is set up, or more than one: pass config_entry_id.
